release_notes: Replaced the workshop product wall with one physical terminal that opens a centered key catalog.
Made every key mechanically distinct: C Loft, D Drift, E Relay, G Glide, and A Burst each have unique lift, travel, variance, and scoring risk.
Removed player-adjustable key angles. Keys remain flat and sample deterministic random response cones on every hit.
Retired active spotlight, hype, streak, encore, and concert-rating multipliers to keep scoring focused on rebounds and musical routes.
Migrated existing arrangements safely to the fixed-key layout while preserving snapshot compatibility.
Added an explicitly unimplemented incremental-progression proposal beneath Latest Releases.
Passed the complete `npm test` suite and generated the production web export with `npm run build`.
